prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1199; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change. Insured vehicle reports contact to the rear passenger-side quarter panel of the claimant's vehicle. Claimant reports neck pain and headache and states a concussion was diagnosed at the emergency department. Claimant is not represented by an attorney. Recorded statement requested.

Entry 2: Recorded statement obtained from the claimant. Claimant describes the other vehicle drifting into their lane at highway speed and says they were struck while attempting to avoid a collision. Claimant reports ongoing dizziness, light sensitivity and difficulty concentrating. Discussed the medical authorization form and explained the claimant may choose to consult an attorney. Claimant indicated they will consider it.

Entry 3: Insured's statement taken. Insured states they checked the mirror and signaled before moving left but did not see the claimant's vehicle in the blind spot. Insured accepts that contact occurred and reports no prior similar incidents. Scene photos and insured's dashcam footage requested for review.

Entry 4: Police report received and reviewed. Report notes the lane change was cited as the contributing factor and includes a witness account consistent with the claimant's version. Medical records requested from the treating clinic and neurology follow-up. Records for the prior twelve months requested to check for previous head injuries or treatment.

Entry 5: Liability assessment in progress. Evidence to date points to the insured as primarily at fault for the sideswipe. Injury evaluation pending receipt of medical records and treating physician's prognosis. Claimant contacted to update on status and to confirm contact details for ongoing correspondence. Reserve review scheduled for next file review.
